en.heading: Turn the view: how is starlight arranged?
en.drag: Drag or use arrow keys to rotate; the stars keep their positions.
en.boundary: Illustrative reconstruction · dots are not individual catalogued stars and brightness is not a star count. Cases use independent framing, so their sizes cannot be measured against each other.
en.fallback: A rotatable simplified drawing is active. The explanation and spatial positions remain available.
en.onward: Start a new journey at the chosen origin →
en.zoomHandoff: For physical distances, open the zoom-out question. A new journey starts at the chosen Earth or Sun; resuming keeps the scale reached earlier.
en.sun: Sun in the disk · about 26,000 ly from centre
en.coordinate: x and y lie in the disk; z is perpendicular · illustrative axes
en.normalized: Independent framing, no shared size ruler
en.projected: The view changes its appearance, not its category
en.shortBoundary: Illustrative 3D structure · cases are framed independently; dots are not measured star counts.
en.orionRegion: These seven Orion stars · near the Sun
en.comparisonBoundary: One length ruler · selected stellar bodies, not halo boundaries
en.comparisonHint: Compare on one length ruler; inspect one to see small-galaxy detail.

child.zh: 先找金色的太阳定位环。转到侧面，它仍留在薄盘里，中央鼓起的核球和周围稀疏的晕却不会一起变薄。
child.en: Find the gold Sun locator. Turn edge-on: it stays in the thin disk, while the central bulge and sparse halo retain their depth.

title.en: One Milky Way: disk, bulge and halo

theory.zh: 银河是棒旋星系。盘中的恒星、气体与尘埃形成扁平结构；中央核球与棒更集中，恒星晕较稀疏并伸展到盘外。正面有利于看旋臂，侧面有利于看厚度与尘埃带。太阳位于盘内，距银河中心约 2.6 万光年。
theory.en: The Milky Way is a barred spiral. Its disk contains stars, gas and dust; its central bulge and bar are concentrated, while the sparse stellar halo extends outside the disk. Face-on views reveal arms; edge-on views reveal thickness and dust lanes. The Sun lies in the disk about 26,000 light-years from the centre.

evidence.zh: 我们身处银河内部，外观需要用恒星距离、运动与不同波段观测重建。外部三维视图不是银河外面拍回来的照片。
evidence.en: From inside the Milky Way, astronomers reconstruct its appearance using stellar distances, motions and observations at different wavelengths. This external view is not a photograph taken outside our galaxy.

limits.zh: 盘半径取约 5 万光年作结构参照，太阳定位取其 0.52；臂、棒、晕与厚度为教学几何。金环不表示太阳直径。这里显示恒星晕，不显示推断的暗物质晕，也不模拟恒星轨道。 从猎户座定位返回时，青色点另用目录方向和指定距离估计标出那七颗亮星；不把它们混同于统计背景点。
limits.en: A rounded 50,000-light-year disk radius makes the solar locator radius 0.52. Arms, bar, halo and thickness are teaching geometry. The gold ring is not the Sun’s diameter. This shows a stellar halo, not an inferred dark-matter halo, and does not simulate stellar orbits. After locating Orion, cyan marks use catalogue directions and the selected distance estimates for those seven stars, distinct from statistical background samples.

sources.title: ESA Gaia · Guide to our galaxy

name.zh: 仙女座星系M31：另一座旋涡星系

child.zh: M31和银河都有恒星盘，但这里要找的是M31偏心、断续的尘埃和恒星形成环，以及较显著的中央恒星群。它们不是复制银河的四条等强旋臂。
child.en: M31 and the Milky Way have stellar disks, but look for M31’s offset, broken dust and star-forming rings and prominent central stellar population. They are not copies of four equal Milky Way arms.

title.zh: 从仙女座方向的小光斑，到一整座星系
title.en: From a smudge in Andromeda’s direction to a whole galaxy

theory.zh: 旋涡星系有盘、旋臂和中央成分。臂中的年轻亮星及恒星形成区能突出旋臂，但臂间也有恒星。倾斜角会改变投影形状；看不见旋臂并不能单独证明它没有盘。
theory.en: Spiral galaxies contain a disk, arms and a central component. Young bright stars and star-forming regions can emphasize the arms, but stars also occupy the spaces between them. Inclination changes the projected shape; hidden arms alone do not demonstrate the absence of a disk.

evidence.zh: M31距离约250万光年，在合适的暗夜条件下可见为模糊光斑。仙女座是天空区域；前景恒星属于银河系，M31则在远处。这里的可旋转外观是结构示意，不是测得每颗恒星深度的实景。
evidence.en: M31 is about 2.5 million light-years away and appears as a faint smudge under suitable dark skies. Andromeda names a sky region: foreground stars belong to our Milky Way and M31 lies beyond. This rotatable appearance is a structural illustration, not measured depths for every star.

limits.zh: 形态参考M31的可见光与红外观测；环、弧段和恒星分布为结构示意，三维深度不是逐星测量。不同波段凸显不同成分，不能把所绘环数当作完整、确定的旋臂数量。
limits.en: Visible and infrared M31 observations guide the morphology. Rings, arcs and stars illustrate structure; depth is not a measured star catalogue. Different wavelengths highlight different components, and the drawn rings do not establish a complete spiral-arm count.

name.en: M87: a galaxy without prominent arms

child.zh: M87也属于星系这一层级，却没有银河系那样明显的旋臂。转动它的平滑恒星体，看看星光怎样填满有厚度的空间。
child.en: M87 is a galaxy too, with no prominent Milky-Way-like spiral arms. Turn its smooth stellar body and see starlight filling a volume.

title.zh: 椭圆形是投影，不是空心轮廓
title.en: An elliptical projection, not a hollow outline

theory.zh: 椭圆星系的光分布通常较平滑，外观从近圆到拉长不等，通常缺少明显旋臂。它们常以较老恒星为主，冷气体和近期恒星形成通常较少；这不是对每个星系都成立的年龄判定。
theory.en: Elliptical galaxies usually have smoother light distributions, from nearly round to elongated, without prominent spiral arms. Older stars often dominate, with relatively little cold gas or recent star formation. Shape alone is not an age measurement for every galaxy.

evidence.zh: M87是室女座星系团中的巨椭圆星系。观测图像显示平滑的恒星光分布；这里用体积分布解释其形态，不重建未知的逐星三维位置。
evidence.en: M87 is a giant elliptical in the Virgo Cluster. Images reveal a smooth stellar light distribution; this volume explains its morphology without claiming unknown individual 3D stellar positions.

limits.zh: 这是受M87形态启发的中心较密三轴体，不是精确实测模型，也不与银河系共用大小尺。旋涡、椭圆与不规则是并列案例，不是所有星系必经的演化顺序。
limits.en: This centrally concentrated triaxial illustration is inspired by M87’s morphology, not an exact measured reconstruction or a common-size comparison with the Milky Way. Spiral, elliptical and irregular are alternative examples, not a compulsory evolutionary sequence.

name.zh: 巴纳德星系 NGC 6822：不规则星系
name.en: Barnard’s Galaxy NGC 6822: an irregular galaxy

child.zh: 这座有名字的邻居叫巴纳德星系。看看较分散的星光和偏在一旁的蓝白亮区：它们没有排成整齐的旋臂。转动的是结构示意，不是望远镜能拍到的另一个方向。
child.en: This named neighbour is Barnard’s Galaxy. Compare its diffuse starlight with the uneven blue-white concentrations: they do not form tidy spiral arms. Turning explores an illustrative structure, not another camera view observed by a telescope.

title.zh: 不规则星系也有自己的结构
title.en: An irregular galaxy has its own structure

theory.zh: 巴纳德星系 NGC 6822 是本星系群中的矮不规则星系。整体较弥散的恒星分布与局部年轻恒星、恒星形成区并不均匀重合；不规则不等于随意散点。恒星颜色、气体和运动等证据帮助研究其历史，单凭外形不能断定发生过哪一次碰撞。
theory.en: Barnard’s Galaxy, NGC 6822, is a dwarf irregular member of the Local Group. Its diffuse stellar population and local concentrations of young stars and star-forming regions are unevenly distributed; irregular does not mean random dots. Stellar colours, gas and motions help investigate its history; shape alone cannot establish a particular collision.

evidence.zh: Euclid 对整个 NGC 6822 及周边的观测辨认出恒星形成区和球状星团；它是一座有观测依据的真实星系。
evidence.en: Euclid observations of the whole NGC 6822 field identify star-forming regions and globular clusters: this is a real, observed galaxy.

limits.zh: 布局参考 NGC 6822 的观测形态；三维深度、单个星点、颜色与亮度是教学示意，不是逐星测量或精确实测重建。切换案例是在比较，不是星系演化时钟。
limits.en: The layout is inspired by observations of NGC 6822. Depth, individual points, colours and brightness are illustrative, not a measured star catalogue or an exact reconstruction. Case changes compare examples rather than advance an evolutionary clock.

sources.title: ESA · Euclid’s view of irregular galaxy NGC 6822

name.en: Star cluster: a group inside a galaxy

child.zh: 金环里的亮点是一团属于银河的球状星团；连线另一端放大的是同一个星团。它位于银晕中，不必贴在发亮的薄盘上。定位亮点特意放大，两幅图也不是同一把大小尺。
child.en: The light inside the gold ring is a globular cluster belonging to the Milky Way; the connector leads to the same cluster enlarged. It lies in the stellar halo, so it need not sit on the bright disk. The locator is enlarged, and the two views use different scales.

title.zh: 星团、星系、星系群是不同层次
title.en: Star clusters, galaxies and galaxy groups

theory.zh: 球状星团是紧密、近球形的恒星集合；银河拥有许多这样的星团，也有更松散的疏散星团。星系是更广大的系统，包含不同恒星群及气体等成分，通常还与暗物质有关。星系群的成员则是多座星系。不能只凭“圆不圆”或画面亮点多少分类。
theory.en: Globular clusters are compact, roughly spherical stellar collections; the Milky Way hosts many, as well as looser open clusters. A galaxy is a larger system containing different stellar populations and other components such as gas, usually associated with dark matter. A galaxy group contains multiple galaxies. Roundness and the number of drawn dots do not define these categories.

evidence.zh: 星团和星系的区别需结合尺度、恒星群与引力运动等证据；少数边界对象的历史可能复杂。
evidence.en: Distinguishing clusters and galaxies uses scale, stellar populations and gravitational motions; some borderline objects can have complex histories.

limits.zh: 星团位置和内部恒星分布为示例，不对应某个已命名星团。两图复用同一组恒星示意；定位符号放大，大小与距离不可从图上量取。连线只表归属与放大，不是轨道；不把星团与星系之间的区别归结为统一的恒星数量门槛。
limits.en: The location and stellar distribution are an example, not a named cluster. Both views reuse the same stellar sample; the locator is enlarged and sizes and distances cannot be measured here. The connector denotes membership and magnification, not an orbit. No universal star-count threshold defines the cluster–galaxy distinction.

name.zh: 本星系群：恒星点还是星系？

child.zh: 刚才一座星系里的光点代表星光分布；到了这一层，小定位环代表整座小星系。找出银河、仙女座和三角座，再观察它们周围并不均匀的小成员。
child.en: Inside one galaxy, dots illustrated starlight. At this level, small locator rings denote whole dwarf galaxies. Find the Milky Way, Andromeda and Triangulum, then notice the uneven smaller members around them.

title.zh: 星系组成群，而不是挤成一个巨星团
title.en: Galaxies form a group, not a giant star cluster

theory.zh: 本星系群包含银河、仙女座、三角座等较大成员和许多矮星系。银河与仙女座之间相隔约 250 万光年。群体不均匀，成员各有自己的结构；从这一层观察时，一颗恒星和一座星系的标记不能混读。
theory.en: The Local Group includes the Milky Way, Andromeda, Triangulum and many dwarf galaxies. Andromeda is about 2.5 million light-years from the Milky Way. Members are not evenly distributed and retain their own structures; a star symbol and a galaxy locator belong to different levels.

evidence.zh: 成员关系和距离由观测建立；完整成员普查会随新的微弱星系发现而更新。
evidence.en: Observations establish distances and membership; the census changes as faint galaxies are discovered.

limits.zh: 本图为可旋转归属示意，距离、方向和成员尺寸不共用物理比例；小圈只是位置样本，不是数量普查。若要比较距离量级，请进入连续拉远；室女座星系团仍是另一个邻近结构。
limits.en: This rotatable membership illustration has no common physical scale for separations, directions and member sizes. Small rings are sample locators, not a census. Use the continuous zoom for distance scales; the Virgo Cluster remains a separate nearby structure.

name.zh: 银河光带：从里面到外面
name.en: Milky Way band: inside to outside

child.zh: 太阳也是恒星；夜空中许多星点是银河内很远的恒星。行星和卫星也能因反光而显亮，一个未分开的亮点还可能包含多颗恒星。银河光带则是许多恒星的光混在一起。
child.en: The Sun is a star. Many points in our night sky are distant Milky Way stars. Planets and satellites can also shine by reflected light, and an unresolved point may contain multiple stars. The Milky Way band blends light from many stars.

title.zh: 天上的银河，就是我们身处其中的银河系
title.en: The sky band belongs to the galaxy we live inside

theory.zh: 盘内不同方向穿过的恒星分布和尘埃不同。沿盘面会积累较多星光，离开盘面通常较少；尘埃遮挡形成暗带。选择仙女座方向，可在银河前景星的后面定位约250万光年外的M31，它不是银河的一颗恒星。 恒星能够自己发光；天空中的亮点不能一概当作单颗恒星，行星、卫星和未分开的多星系统需另加区分。未命名的渲染点只表示星光分布。
theory.en: Different directions from inside the disk cross different stellar populations and dust. Looking along the disk accumulates more starlight; looking away usually crosses less. Dust obscuration creates dark lanes. In the Andromeda direction, M31 lies about 2.5 million light-years beyond Milky Way foreground stars; it is not one of our galaxy’s stars. Stars emit their own light, but sky points are not all single stars: planets, satellites and unresolved multiple systems need to be distinguished. Unnamed rendered points represent a distribution of starlight.

evidence.zh: 银河光带、恒星测距与多波段巡天支持盘内解释。已命名前景星使用J2000方向，M31使用目录方向；银河弥散光与外观来自同一结构模型，不是实拍。 地面夜空的低对比灰白光带参考暗夜观感说明；它来自大量未分辨恒星，暗尘云使其斑驳，灯光和月光降低能见度。
evidence.en: The Milky Way band, stellar distances and multiwavelength surveys support the inside-disk explanation. Named foreground stars and M31 use catalogued J2000 directions. Diffuse Galactic light and the external view come from the same structural model, not a photograph. The low-contrast grey-white ground view follows descriptions of dark-sky appearance: unresolved stars form the band, dust makes it uneven, and artificial light and moonlight reduce visibility.

limits.zh: 这是选定朝向的增强教学视野，不是某个地点和时刻的观星预报。未命名星点、尘埃和弥散星光是稳定示意；亮度不作测光。镜头移动不是飞船航行，M31仅用方向标记表示，不与本银河盘共用距离比例。
limits.en: This enhanced teaching view has a chosen direction, not a sky forecast for a place and time. Unnamed star points, dust and diffuse light are stable illustrations, not calibrated photometry. Observer travel is not a spacecraft flight. M31 is a directional marker and does not share the Galactic disk’s distance scale.

sources.title: NASA · Andromeda halo and sky appearance
NPS · Natural light in the night sky
INAF · The Milky Way and light at night

name.zh: 猎户座：星星真的挨在一起吗？
name.en: Orion: are its stars really neighbours?

child.zh: 先找腰带上的三颗星，再把观察位置移到侧面。同样的七个恒星定位点有远有近；回到地球附近，熟悉的图案又出现了。
child.en: Find the three belt stars, then move the observer sideways. The same seven star locators lie at different depths. Return near Earth and the familiar pattern reappears.

title.zh: 星座图案是视线的投影
title.en: A constellation pattern is a projection along our sightlines

theory.zh: 用目录赤经、赤纬确定方向，再用一个有出处的距离估计构造三维位置。星体保持原位，改变观察者就会改变图案。星座是天空区域，连线是认图辅助；其中部分恒星可能属于同一星协，不能一概说彼此毫无关系。
theory.en: Catalogue right ascension and declination set direction; one sourced distance estimate supplies depth. Stars keep their positions while the observer changes the pattern. Constellations are sky regions and connecting lines are recognition aids. Some stars can share an association, so not all are physically unrelated.

evidence.zh: 七颗亮星的方向和视差采用CDS索引的2007年Hipparcos重处理值。距离用视差倒数换算，并显示视差正负一个形式误差对应的非对称距离区间。这是一组明确年代的比较输入，不是最新距离定论。
evidence.en: Directions and parallaxes for seven bright stars use the CDS-indexed 2007 Hipparcos reduction. Reciprocal parallax supplies a selected distance, with an asymmetric interval from parallax plus/minus one formal error. These are explicitly dated comparison inputs, not a latest distance consensus.

limits.zh: 亮星表面变化、多星结构会影响测距，参宿四和腰带多星的其他研究可给出不同距离。范围条不包括所有系统误差，也不是完整概率后验。点是放大的定位符，不是恒星直径；没有计算自行、轨道或相对论航行。
limits.en: Bright-star surface variability and multiplicity affect astrometry; other studies give different distances for Betelgeuse and belt systems. Bars omit possible systematic errors and are not full posterior intervals. Dots are enlarged locators, not stellar diameters. Proper motion, stellar orbits and relativistic travel are not computed.

sources.title: Shenar et al. 2015 · Mintaka distance caveat

name.zh: 太阳系与TRAPPIST-1：完整行星系统
name.en: Solar System and TRAPPIST-1: whole planetary systems

child.zh: 先看两套行星系统的全貌：太阳与八颗行星，红矮星TRAPPIST-1与七颗已知行星。点选成员、转动或播放，再切换共同AU尺，比较轨道到底有多紧凑。
child.en: Start with both planetary families: our Sun and eight planets, and red dwarf TRAPPIST-1 with seven known planets. Select members, turn or play, then switch to a common AU ruler to compare orbital compactness.

title.zh: 同一层级，不同的行星系统布局
title.en: Same system level, different orbital layouts

theory.zh: TRAPPIST-1是一颗红矮星，周围已知七颗大小接近地球的岩质行星。轨道半长轴和周期采用Agol等2021年的选定估计。近似圆轨道共面显示，所有行星共享同一AU换算和同一演示天数，内侧通常更快。
theory.en: TRAPPIST-1 is a red dwarf with seven known roughly Earth-sized rocky planets. Selected semimajor axes and periods follow Agol et al. 2021. Approximate circular coplanar orbits share one AU conversion and one elapsed-day clock; inner planets generally go around faster.

evidence.zh: 凌日与凌日时间变化约束行星周期、半径和系统参数。共同尺展示轨道尺度，不把行星画面圆盘当成真实大小；放大后的表面是帮助辨认的假想岩石外观。
evidence.en: Transits and transit-timing variations constrain periods, radii and system parameters. The common ruler measures orbital scales, not the enlarged body symbols. Close-up rocky appearances are hypothetical recognition illustrations.

limits.zh: 未求解多体引力、偏心率、共振或真实历元。近景更换取景范围但不改变轨道半径；水星轨道超出近景时有提示。没有已知表面照片，不据此判断海洋、大气或生命。恒星物理与双星机制仍由恒星专题讲解。 全貌为可读性将两套轨道分别展开，不用于量距；太阳系圆轨道周期按选用的半长轴和开普勒关系近似。太阳系图谱复用已有署名资源，TRAPPIST-1表面仍是假想外观。
limits.en: This does not solve many-body gravity, eccentricity or resonances, or use a measured orbital epoch. Close-up changes framing, not orbital radii; Mercury is marked as outside the view. No observed surface maps are available, and the drawing establishes no oceans, atmospheres or life. Stellar physics and binary mechanisms remain in the stars topic. Whole views spread both orbital layouts for readability without a distance ruler. Solar circular-orbit periods are approximated from selected semimajor axes and Kepler’s relation. Solar maps reuse attributed assets; TRAPPIST-1 surfaces remain hypothetical.

sources.title: NASA Exoplanet Archive · TRAPPIST-1, Agol et al. 2021

name.zh: 银河与邻居：同尺比较所选主体
name.en: Milky Way and neighbours: one ruler for selected stellar bodies

child.zh: 先比较所选恒星主体的大小与厚薄，再用「单独观察」看细节。这里共用光年尺；不把星晕当作有硬边界的球壳。
child.en: Compare selected stellar bodies and their thickness, then inspect one for detail. Both use the same light-year ruler; stellar halos are not hard-edged shells.

title.zh: 同一把尺，与相同的边界定义是两回事
title.en: A common ruler is not a common edge definition

theory.zh: 图中使用取整的主体跨度参考：银河恒星盘约10万光年，M31恒星盘约20万光年，M87选定明亮主体约12万光年。NGC 6822用GALEX表中0.50 Mpc距离与16角分长轴换算约7600光年。所有几何采用同一光年换算；这些参考不使用统一表面亮度阈值，不能据此排列总质量或完整星晕大小。
theory.en: Rounded reference spans are 100,000 light-years for the Milky Way stellar disk, 200,000 for M31’s disk and 120,000 for a selected bright M87 body. NGC 6822 uses about 7,600 light-years derived from a 0.50-Mpc distance and a 16-arcminute major axis in the GALEX table. Geometry shares one light-year conversion, but these references do not share an isophotal threshold and cannot rank total masses or complete halos.

evidence.zh: 主体跨度参考来自NASA资料与GALEX邻近星系表；星系的外围范围还会随观测深度和所选恒星或气体成分改变。
evidence.en: Reference extents come from NASA material and the GALEX nearby-galaxy table. Outer extents also depend on observing depth and the stellar or gaseous component selected.

limits.zh: 同尺仅指长度换算一致；摆放位置、恒星点群与视向为结构示意，不是它们真实相邻。所选主体范围不是统一等亮度直径，也不包括完整暗物质晕、气体晕或极暗恒星外围；星点数和亮度不可用来测质量。
limits.en: Common scale means a common length conversion. Placement, stellar samples and orientation are illustrative, not real adjacency. Selected body extents are not uniform-isophote diameters and do not include complete dark-matter halos, gas halos or very faint stellar outskirts. Point counts and brightness cannot measure mass.

sources.title: NASA/GALEX · nearby galaxy angular extents and distances

name.en: Kepler-16: two stars and a planet

child.zh: 两颗恒星都自己发光，行星主要反射恒星光。先看两颗星围绕共同重心运动，再追踪围着这一对恒星运行的 Kepler-16 b。
child.en: Both stars shine by themselves; the planet mainly reflects starlight. Follow the stars around their shared centre of mass, then the known planet Kepler-16 b around the pair.

title.en: A binary can host a planet

theory.zh: Kepler-16 b 是经观测确认的环双星行星。演示采用 Doyle 等（2011）一组参数：双星周期约41.08天，已知行星周期约228.78天；双星质量约0.690与0.203太阳质量。它是恒星与行星组成的系统，不是一座星系。
theory.en: Kepler-16 b is an observed circumbinary planet. The illustration uses one Doyle et al. (2011) parameter set: about 41.08 days for the stars and 228.78 days for the planet, with stellar masses about 0.690 and 0.203 solar masses. This is a stellar/planetary system, not a galaxy.

evidence.zh: 凌日观测与后来独立的径向速度观测支持这颗环双星行星的存在；不同研究给出的参数有误差与差异。
evidence.en: Transit observations and later independent radial-velocity observations support the planet; estimates differ between studies and have uncertainties.

limits.zh: 轨道分别按指定椭圆近似、采用示意起始相位；没有计算双星对行星的完整引力扰动或长期稳定性。定位球放大，行星表面是假想插画，不是实拍。
limits.en: Specified ellipses and illustrative initial phases are used without integrating the full binary perturbations or long-term stability. Body locators are enlarged and the planet surface is an illustration, not a photograph.

sources.title: NASA/JPL · A planet orbiting two stars

name.zh: 天鹅座 X-1：恒星与黑洞
name.en: Cygnus X-1: a star and a black hole

child.zh: 一颗蓝超巨星与一个黑洞组成双星系统。黑洞本身不发光，周围吸积的热气体能够发出辐射；这里不添加未经证实的行星。
child.en: A blue supergiant and a black hole form a binary. The black hole emits no light of its own; hot accreting gas radiates. No unconfirmed planets are added.

title.zh: 发亮的环不等于黑洞本身
title.en: The glowing gas is not the black hole

theory.zh: 天鹅座 X-1 是银河中的恒星质量黑洞伴星系统，不是银河中心那类超大质量黑洞，也不是一座独立星系。轨道采用约5.60天的近圆双星参考；演示以约40.6与21.2太阳质量推算近似尺度。伴星的恒星风为吸积提供物质。
theory.en: Cygnus X-1 is a stellar-mass black-hole binary in the Milky Way, not a central supermassive black hole or a separate galaxy. A roughly 5.60-day nearly circular reference and masses about 40.6 and 21.2 solar masses set an approximate orbit scale. The companion wind supplies accreting material.

evidence.zh: 伴星运动、距离测量和X射线等多种证据共同约束系统；热气体和恒星的辐射不能当作看到了黑洞内部。
evidence.en: Companion motions, distance measurements and X-rays constrain the system. Radiation from the star and gas does not reveal the black-hole interior.

limits.zh: 圆轨道为两体近似，采用示意相位与视向；黑洞定位球放大，热气体颜色和流线仅解释风供给，不是可见光实拍、流体模拟或广义相对论光线追踪。此处没有已确认行星的展示。
limits.en: A circular two-body approximation uses illustrative phase and orientation. The black-hole locator is enlarged; gas colours and paths explain wind feeding rather than reproduce a visible-light photograph, fluid simulation or relativistic ray tracing. No confirmed planet is shown here.
